time_et: applies from now on, all days
rule: PRE-MARKET CARRY AT THE CASH OPEN. Any NY_PRE (or earlier) position still open at 09:30 is resolved AT the 09:30 open: if it is in PROFIT, stop goes to break-even (it may keep running); if it is in DRAWDOWN, it is FLATTENED at the open price. No pre-market trade carries live risk through the 09:30 candle.
his_words: All pre-market trades: if they have not hit take profit or are in drawdown during market open, I move everything to break even by the time that the 9:30 candle arrives. The 9:30 candle is so volatile that even if the trade's going well, you can get stopped out at the click of your fingers... If it was in drawdown, close it.
scoring_consequence: such a trade is NEVER logged at the full stop distance. Its R is measured to the 09:30 open (drawdown case) or to break-even//its eventual exit (profit case).
provenance: Angus, 2026-08-12, mid-run. Extends PLAYBOOK constraint 11 ('move to break-even before the cash open') with the drawdown-flatten branch.

time_et: applies from now on, all days
rule: BREAK-EVEN TRIGGER = the intermediate band must be BROKEN, not touched. Once price breaks through the band, the stop moves to break-even - and because the BE stop sits on the far side of that band, price must break back through the SAME band to take you out.
his_words: in that trade, i would wait for it to break that band before moving to BE. that means it would then have to break the band it just broke through to break even me.
supersedes: my literal reading of PLAYBOOK 5 ('move to break-even on touching an intermediate band'), which would have moved nearly every trade to BE within half an R of entry. Touch is not the trigger; a break is.
